decisions.rationale: The median-of-three implementation clamps to inclusive ordered bounds; diff check and the committed test pass.
The candidate replaces case-insensitive sorting with case-sensitive sorting, and the committed contract test fails.
Changing <= to < excludes the required equality boundary; the boundary test fails.
The candidate reverses the required test assertion, causing the committed suite to fail even though the implementation returns true.

strategy_update: Select claims only after direct specification, diff, and test validation; reject unequivocal contract or suite failures.
